entries.reason: The assistant's AG-UI SSE stream: the SPA posts to it from assistant/agui/client.ts with a URL built by a function (not a fetchApi or fetch(`${getBaseUrl()}…`) call site), so no mock-coverage.json probe can name it; check:mock cannot probe a stream either. The mock serves it for every assistant run in npm run dev.

Starting a prototype draft has no SPA caller until the assistant's draft tool (docs/prototype-builder.md, part 2's next slice); the e2e prototype-draft spec and scripts/mock-prototype-drafts.test.mjs start drafts over the API, as MCP and scripts do.
